paths.policies: Settings > Policies. Under Written policies, click a policy. Insert template gives you a starting draft where it's offered.
paths.policiesShow: Shopify links your policies in the checkout footer, the return policy on the order review page and the shipping policy on product pages and the cart.
paths.testMode: Settings > Payments. In Shopify Payments click Manage, then in Test mode select Enable test mode and Save. Pay with card 4242424242424242, any future date, a two-word name and any 3-digit code. Turn test mode off before launch so real payments go through.
paths.freeShipping: Settings > Shipping and delivery. Open your shipping profile, click the menu next to a shipping option, Edit shipping option, select Offer free shipping and enter the minimum order amount. Done, then Save.
paths.openStore: Online Store. Click the Private label in the access setting, select Public, then Update (the first time it says Launch store).
paths.import: Products > Import > Add file > Upload and continue > Import products. A product CSV can't be over 15 MB.
paths.domains: Settings > Domains. Buy one from Shopify or connect one you own.
paths.addSection: Online Store > Edit theme > pick the template from the drop-down at the top > Add section.
paths.complementary: Shopify's Search & Discovery app: Product recommendations > Add recommendations, then pick up to 10 complementary products. Your theme needs a complementary products block.
paths.productSeo: Products > click the product > in Search engine listing click the pencil icon > enter the page title, meta description and (optional) URL handle > Save. Shopify says text past 70 characters (title) or 320 characters (description) might get cut off, and not to change a handle often.
paths.altText: Products > click the product > click the image to open Preview media > Add alt text > type it > Save alt text. Up to 512 characters; Shopify recommends 125 or fewer.
paths.homeSeo: Online Store > Preferences. In Social sharing image and SEO, enter a title and meta description for your store, then Save.

rules.tax: Shopify's help center: tax is your responsibility. Check with a local tax authority or a tax accountant.
rules.canSpam: US CAN-SPAM: every marketing email needs your valid physical postal address and a clear way to opt out, opt-outs are honored within 10 business days, and the subject line must match the content. Email tools add the address and unsubscribe link from your account settings.
rules.formerPrice: FTC rule (16 CFR 233.1): a crossed-out compare-at price must be a real price you actually offered regularly for a reasonably substantial time. A made-up higher price is deceptive. Leave Compare-at price blank until you have a real former price.
rules.images: Shopify: square product images usually display best at 2048 x 2048 px; images can be up to 5000 x 5000 px (25 megapixels) and under 20 MB; PNG first, then JPEG. Keep one aspect ratio for featured images so collection pages line up.

messaging: Shopify Messaging (formerly Shopify Email) sends email campaigns from your Shopify admin. Pricing depends on how many messages you send: check current rates.
schedule: In your Shopify admin, go to Products and click the product name.
In the Product status section, check the status is Active. A product still in Draft at the scheduled time is not published.
In the Publishing section, click the calendar icon next to Online Store, then choose the date and time.
Click Schedule publishing, then click Save.
Check the time zone in Settings > General > Store defaults, so the product goes live at the right hour.
